decisions.reason: The fifteen-day express program is a low-cost service variant close to the core offer, and it is still visible on the website, so it meets the delivery aspiration without straining slack and gives no trigger for problemistic search.
The seventy-two-hour express program is somewhat costlier to run, but it remains listed and supports the firm's fast-response promise, so management will tolerate it while its results are uncertain.
The express product line has had a dedicated page in both years, which signals sustained commitment and performance at or above aspiration for a core extension of the door and gate business.

The online ordering and digital services platform is a strategic investment for trade partners with its own page in both years, and the firm's slack lets it carry uncertain returns given the move toward deeper service support.
The fire and smoke protection door was upgraded to its own page in 2024, which suggests results exceeded aspiration, and it likely absorbed resources from the dropped fire-resistant door C.
